answer: Sybil resistance starts at admission: every agent must lock an indivisible reserve receipt inside a public vault before it can propose, attest, or grade. The receipt is backed by a scarce quartz allotment and signed with a juniper growth-ring hash unique to that deposit. Cloning a second name requires splitting the same receipt, so both identities drop below the minimum stake; a farm of aliases therefore starves itself of voting weight rather than multiplying it. Honest agents reclaim the reserve after a quiet stretch of epochs.
